priorFeatures.pointInTimeStatus: PROVEN — season-level rule eligible_from_season=season+1; _prior_lookup takes latest row with season ≤ Y-1; no same-season evidence
priorFeatures.rightsStatus: PERMITTED — SABR_LAHMAN_MODERN_MLB, LOCAL_PRIVATE_MODEL_DEVELOPMENT allowed, attribution required
priorFeatures.materializationFeasibility: TRIVIAL — components are already read by feature_view._pitching_features and discarded after division
priorFeatures.scientificValueTier: MEDIUM (via the H component: the executable set has SO/BB/HR/HBP per BFP but NO hits-allowed rate; H per out is the only ball-in-play hit-suppression evidence available)
priorFeatures.redundancyAssessment: WHIP itself is a near-linear combination of pitcher_bb_per_bfp (executable) and hits-allowed rate; the ratio is redundant, the H component is not
priorFeatures.rationale: Materialize IPouts, H, BB (Wave 1). Let the engine apply the declared GAMMA_POISSON_COMPONENT_SHRINKAGE to H/IPouts and BB/IPouts and reconstruct the WHIP posterior; do not treat the raw ratio as the primary feature.
priorFeatures.unresolvedEvidence: None for the components. Extreme raw ratios (max 12.0 in development) arise from IPouts < 9 and are the case shrinkage exists for.

sourceCoverage.denominator: same as WHIP; ER p10/50/90 = 2/16/59, 198 zero-ER rows

priorFeatures.materializationFeasibility: TRIVIAL (one additional integer column beyond WHIP's IPouts)
priorFeatures.scientificValueTier: LOW for an 8-class plate-appearance outcome target: ERA aggregates sequencing, defense, bullpen stranding and official-scorer earned/unearned judgments; its outcome content is already carried by SO/BB/HR/H components
priorFeatures.redundancyAssessment: HIGH — dominated by the component rates; raw ratio is unstable at low IPouts (development max 108.0)
priorFeatures.rationale: Do not materialize ER merely to clear the blocker. If a run-level construct is ever wanted, R (runs allowed) and ER are both present and can be added in a later wave with the same lineage; nothing about the PA-outcome challenger needs them.

sourceCoverage.denominator: G p10/50/90 = 2/19/60; GS/G: 1,973 pure relievers (0), 662 pure starters (1), 827 mixed

priorFeatures.scientificValueTier: LOW-MEDIUM as a direct feature (stuff is already measured by rolling K/whiff/velocity); MEDIUM as the pitcher role-taxonomy input (Phase 6)
priorFeatures.redundancyAssessment: Partly redundant with rolling stuff features; unique as a role signal (starter vs reliever times-through-order regime)
priorFeatures.rationale: G and GS ride along at zero marginal cost in the annual bundle and are the exact Beta-Binomial exposure the engine already names (BETA_BINOMIAL_EMPIRICAL_BAYES_REQUIRES_G). Their main scientific use is the deferred role prior, not the raw ratio.

sourceCoverage.denominator: AB: 3,204 of 5,876 prior rows are zero-AB (Lahman pitcher/pinch rows) → rate None; AB<50 in 3,753 rows

priorFeatures.materializationFeasibility: TRIVIAL — components already read by feature_view._batting_features
priorFeatures.scientificValueTier: HIGH — not as SLG, but as the compositional count vector {1B, 2B, 3B, HR, SO, BB+HBP, BIP_OUT, other} that is the natural Dirichlet-Multinomial prior over the challenger's own 8 outcome classes; SLG collapses that vector into one weighted scalar
priorFeatures.redundancyAssessment: SLG is a weighted sum of hr_per_pa (executable) and hit/extra-base components; the 2B/3B/1B split is the non-redundant content
priorFeatures.implementationCost: LOW (5 integer columns; the engine's declared DIRICHLET_MULTINOMIAL_COMPONENT_SHRINKAGE becomes executable)
priorFeatures.rationale: Materialize AB, H, 2B, 3B, HR (plus BB, HBP, SF, SH, SO for the full PA composition) in Wave 1 and let the prior engine shrink the component vector; retain the raw SLG rate only as a derived display.

priorFeatures.materializationFeasibility: TRIVIAL (all five components are in the Wave 1 batting bundle)
priorFeatures.scientificValueTier: LOW incremental: OBP = f(hit rate, walk+HBP rate) and the executable set already carries batter_bb_hbp_per_pa; the only new content is the hit component, which the SLG/AVG component bundle already supplies
priorFeatures.redundancyAssessment: HIGH — linear in components that are materialized for SLG/AVG
priorFeatures.rationale: Becomes computable for free once the batting bundle exists (the engine's BETA_BINOMIAL_EMPIRICAL_BAYES_REQUIRES_OBP_OPPORTUNITIES can bind AB+BB+HBP+SF), but it should not be a modeling feature alongside the component vector; keep it as a derived display/QA statistic.

priorFeatures.scientificValueTier: MEDIUM via the H/AB hit component (ball-in-play hit skill is the one batting dimension the executable set lacks); LOW as AVG per se
priorFeatures.redundancyAssessment: AVG mixes strikeout avoidance (already so_per_pa) with hit-on-contact skill; the component is the useful part
priorFeatures.rationale: H and AB are in the Wave 1 bundle; the engine can bind BETA_BINOMIAL_EMPIRICAL_BAYES_REQUIRES_AB exactly. Prefer the compositional vector over the scalar.

priorFeatures.registeredDefinition: mean releaseSpeed over pitches with pitchType in {FA,FF,FC,SI} within the last 250 BF strictly before the target game date (features.py:215-217)

exactSourcesFound.sumsq: NOT COMPUTED — one additional aggregate (sum of _fb_velo**2) required

priorFeatures.pointInTimeStatus: PROVEN — window built from rows with gameDate < target gameDate (searchsorted side='left'); same-game and same-day pitches excluded; no intra-game timestamp exists so game-date authority applies
priorFeatures.rightsStatus: PERMITTED for local private development (MLB_STATCAST GOVERNED_LOCAL_RESEARCH_ONLY)
priorFeatures.materializationFeasibility: LOW COST — expose two existing aggregates and add one sum-of-squares aggregate in aggregate_pitch_history and _prior_window_features
priorFeatures.scientificValueTier: MEDIUM-HIGH — velocity is a stable, forecast-time-available stuff measure with low redundancy against K/whiff rates and known injury/fatigue sensitivity
priorFeatures.rationale: Add fastball_velocity_sumsq; publish count/sum/sumsq; the engine's NORMAL_NORMAL_REQUIRES_FASTBALL_COUNT_AND_VARIANCE becomes bindable. Record the FA-family floor anomaly as a domain validation (flag, do not clip).
priorFeatures.unresolvedEvidence: Whether FC (cutter) belongs in the fastball family for velocity is a taxonomy choice already frozen in contracts.py; the audit does not reopen it.

priorFeatures.registeredDefinition: whiff_count/swing_count over the last 250 BF; whiff = {swinging_strike, swinging_strike_blocked, missed_bunt}; swing = whiff ∪ contact where contact = {foul, foul_bunt, foul_tip, hit_into_play*}

exactSourcesFound.vocabulary: contracts.py WHIFF_PITCH_RESULTS / CONTACT_PITCH_RESULTS (frozen; unrecognized results are neither swing nor whiff)

priorFeatures.scientificValueTier: HIGH — swing-and-miss is the most direct pre-outcome stuff signal for the STRIKEOUT class and is only partially captured by pitcher_last250_strikeout_rate
priorFeatures.redundancyAssessment: LOW-MEDIUM (correlated with K rate, distinct denominator)
priorFeatures.rationale: Exact swing denominator exists in memory today; the engine's BETA_BINOMIAL_REQUIRES_SWING_COUNT binds directly.

priorFeatures.registeredDefinition: fastball_count/pitch_count over the last 250 BF; denominator = ALL pitches incl. unclassified/PO/null types (shares may sum < 1)

exactSourcesFound.taxonomy: contracts.py FASTBALL=(FA,FF,FC,SI), BREAKING=(CU,KC,CS,SL,ST,SV), OFFSPEED=(CH,FS,FO,SC,KN,EP); unclassified stays in the denominator (documented)

priorFeatures.scientificValueTier: MEDIUM — pitch mix matters mainly through interactions (platoon, count) and as a stuff/approach proxy; as a marginal main effect it is modest
priorFeatures.redundancyAssessment: The three usage shares are one compositional object; materialize the four counts once and model them as a Dirichlet-Multinomial family, not three independent proportions
priorFeatures.rationale: Publish pitch_count + three family counts; the engine's DIRICHLET_MULTINOMIAL_REQUIRES_PITCH_COUNT binds the whole composition (with an implicit 'other' = pitch_count − Σ family counts).

priorFeatures.registeredDefinition: breaking_count/pitch_count (same window and denominator as fastball usage)
priorFeatures.redundancyAssessment: Component of the same Dirichlet family as fastball/offspeed usage
priorFeatures.rationale: Same counts as fastball usage; one family, one binding.

priorFeatures.redundancyAssessment: Component of the same Dirichlet family
priorFeatures.rationale: Same counts; one family, one binding.

priorFeatures.registeredDefinition: whiff_count/swing_count over the batter's last 100 PA strictly before the target game date
priorFeatures.scientificValueTier: HIGH — batter swing-and-miss is the cleanest pre-outcome contact-skill measure and is only partly captured by batter_last100_strikeout_rate
priorFeatures.redundancyAssessment: LOW-MEDIUM vs strikeout rate; exact complement of contact_rate
priorFeatures.rationale: Exact swing denominator exists; BETA_BINOMIAL_REQUIRES_SWING_COUNT binds directly.

priorFeatures.registeredDefinition: contact_count/swing_count over the same window; SWING_PITCH_RESULTS = WHIFF ∪ CONTACT by construction, so contact_rate = 1 − whiff_rate exactly

exactSourcesFound.counts: features.py (computed, discarded); identity verified from contracts.py:169

priorFeatures.scientificValueTier: ZERO incremental — an exact algebraic complement of batter_last100_whiff_rate
priorFeatures.rationale: Its blocker is cleared by the same swing/whiff counts, but it must not enter a feature set beside whiff_rate; retain as a derived display only.

sourceEvidence.2025-2026: raw MLB Stats API doubleHeader ∈ {N,Y,S} (S = split, 2026 examples: 824132/824134), gameNumber ∈ {1,2}; rescheduledFrom/resumeDate/resumedFrom present in raw, dropped by the curated authority

doubleheader_game_number.suspendedGames: 13 of 7,289 Retrosheet games 2023–2025; original identity/date retained, availability delayed to completion date (final_available_date)
doubleheader_game_number.recommendedSemantics: {0 = not a doubleheader (source proves N / gameNumber 0), 1 = game 1, 2 = game 2, NULL = schedule source absent} plus optional doubleheader_type ∈ {NONE, TRADITIONAL, SPLIT}; a resumed suspended game keeps its original game_number; a same-day resumed game plus a scheduled game is NOT a doubleheader unless the source flags one
